messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — kickoff for StormBridge POC next Tue 10am PT. Goal: align scope, success criteria, and checklist for security/pricing blockers. Linking the draft agenda: <https://redwoodinference.app/notes/stormbridge-poc|doc>.

derek (Solutions Eng): I can lead the technical part. Quick ask: do they plan to use private deployment or hosted API for the POC? That changes infra items.

ev an (StormBridge): evan (StormBridge): We want to start on hosted API but may need a VPC private test if we hit data residency checks. For kickoff, hosted is fine.

alisha (AM): Noted — hosted for now. I'll confirm the stakeholder list. Who from StormBridge will attend?

ev an (StormBridge): Evan here — I'll be the product lead. I'll bring our infra lead (Priya) and data privacy SME (Tom).

derek (Solutions Eng): OK. Draft success criteria suggestions: 1) Latency p50 < 200ms for 512-token generation on c5-like baseline; 2) Prompt set quality: >= 90% pass on curated evals (we'll define pass); 3) Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions for 5 mins without errors; 4) No PII leakage in sample set. Thoughts?

alisha (AM): Those look good. Add business success: model responses reduce average agent handle time by >=20% in demo flows.

sanjay (Customer Eng): I'll prep the eval prompt set. Suggest 40 prompts split by intent: 20 retrieval-assisted, 10 summarization, 10 conversational. We'll run A/B between baseline model and optimized variant.

maria (AE): Timing: propose 3-week POC. Week1: onboarding + infra + baseline runs. Week2: prompt tuning + evals. Week3: perf tuning + handoff. Is that acceptable?

ev an (StormBridge): 3 weeks works. Can we compress onboarding if we use hosted?

lena (Sales Ops): Pricing question from procurement: can we get a capped pilot cost or a trial discount? I'll surface that during kickoff and capture requirements.

maria (AE): We'll offer a capped spend for 3 weeks — draft number TBD with finance. Lena, can you capture expected commit?

lena (Sales Ops): Yep. I'll add to the doc.

compliance-bot: security questionnaire flagged: "Data encryption at rest" unanswered; customer provided an initial SOC2 summary.

sanjay (Customer Eng): I'll own security Qs. For POC we can provide scoped answers and a short checklist: 1) encryption in transit+rest, 2) retention policy (7 days temp logs), 3) access controls. Need Tom (customer) to confirm data sensitivity of sample payloads.

ev an (StormBridge): Tom confirms sample payloads are pseudonymized product logs, no direct PII.

derek (Solutions Eng): Action items before kickoff meeting: 
- Derek: prepare infra checklist & sample curl + python snippets for hosted API (due 24hrs before kickoff)
- Sanjay: draft security Q responses & minimal SOC excerpts (due 48hrs before kickoff)
- Alisha: confirm final attendee list and calendar invite (ASAP)
- Lena: propose pilot cap and payment terms (before kickoff)
- Maria: finalize success criteria and share eval template

maria (AE): I'll run the kickoff agenda. Posting the agenda here:
```
Agenda:
1) Intros & business goals (10m)
2) Use case walkthrough + sample payloads (15m)
3) Success criteria & eval prompts (20m)
4) Infra plan (hosted -> private fallback) + demo snippets (15m)
5) Security & compliance Qs (10m)
6) Timeline, pricing, next steps, owners (10m)
```

derek (Solutions Eng): I'll attach quick code snippet to the doc for the hosted API auth flow:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"Summarize product logs...","max_tokens":256}'
```

ev an (StormBridge): That's helpful. For evals: can you include an example rubric for the 90% pass metric?

sanjay (Customer Eng): Example rubric (short):
- Relevance (0-2)
- Accuracy (0-2)
- Safety (0-1)
- Conciseness (0-1)
Pass if total >=5/6. We'll attach human labels for 40 prompts.

alisha (AM): OK all — I'll send the calendar invite and doc updates by EOD. Anyone object to Tue 10am PT?

ev an (StormBridge): Works for us. See you then.

maria (AE): Great. If any blockers pop up (security redlines or pricing constraints), flag here and we'll escalate to finance/security leads. :thumbsup:

lena (Sales Ops): Will do.

compliance-bot: Note added to thread: "Requested PI data flow diagram". Sanjay please advise.

sanjay (Customer Eng): I'll request the diagram from Tom and share in this thread."
